item.title: Vocal Hut is giving away 3 FREE royalty-free EDM vocal stems exclusively for BPB readers
item.description: Robbie Hutton from Vocal Hut has put together a free vocal pack exclusively for BPB readers. The pack includes three full-length, royalty-free EDM vocals with dry and wet stems, MIDI files, and lyrics folders. Everything is in WAV format and ready to drop into your projects. Both are part of the WET VST project, which is a growing line of plugins built directly on the Steinberg VST3 SDK without JUCE or any third-party framework. item.title: KERN Audio offers a complete plugin mixing chain (SMOOTH, WARM, WIDE + free CHECK)
item.description: You’ve probably read our article about the free KERN CHECK spectral mono compatibility analyzer earlier this month. We absolutely loved it.
